## What's Changed
* Fixed template downloads and component catalog fallback, including installed components when offline.
* Fixed dependency installers with Z: disabled, font installation and reporting installer failures.
* Fixed importing prefix architecture and preserving user files when restoring bottles on another account.
* Fixed desktop shortcuts, executable drag and drop, bottle ordering and component removal controls.
* Fixed UMU controller access and retrying failed game searches.
* Fixed the bottle's Wayland setting for Proton launches.
* Added optional Eagle tracing and native analysis with compatible Soda runners. Other runners keep the existing analyzer and launch path.
* Added the identity bridge for compatible Soda runners, including browser return handling and account storage in the system keyring.
* Changed playtime totals to hours.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bottlesdevs/Bottles/compare/67.4...67.5
